summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K updating the indicative guidance on its subsidiary Vale Base Metals Ltd.'s potential long-term contribution to consolidated EBITDA, now approximately 28%. The update is based on 2026 average analyst estimates for copper, nickel, and gold prices. No transaction, tender, or special situation is involved. This is a routine guidance update by a foreign private issuer; no equivalent US special-situation category applies.
